statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
